tagline: Glen Eden's trusted STIHL and outdoor equipment specialist
heroSubheading: Quality equipment, expert service, and the advice you can count on.
aboutHtml:
For over 30 years, STIHL SHOP Glen Eden has been the region's trusted source for outdoor power equipment. We started as Mr Mowers in 1986 and became New Zealand's first STIHL SHOP in 2003. We're a family-owned business built on knowing both our customers and our gear.

We stock STIHL, Masport, Cub Cadet, Honda, Big Dog, Ziegler, Brown and Silky equipment, with everything from machines to parts and accessories. Whether you shop with us in-store or online, we'll help you find what you need. We also provide servicing and repairs to keep your equipment running well.

We're part of the Glen Eden community, supporting local schools, sports clubs and the RSA. Come in and see why your neighbours turn to us for advice, equipment and service they can rely on. We're here to help you get the job done.
